topic: Embeddings and similarity search (metrics, normalisation, ANN: HNSW/IVF/PQ)
guidance: Angles that are NOT already in v5: choosing and configuring an ANN index (HNSW vs IVF vs PQ: recall, latency, memory, build cost, update behaviour); measuring ANN recall against exact search; inner-product vs cosine index configuration pitfalls with unnormalised vectors; mixing embeddings from two model versions in one index; distance concentration in high dimensions; embedding dimension/memory arithmetic. v5 already has 'cosine vs dot product' (NLP) - do not repeat it.

Chunk size/overlap trade-offs measured by retrieval behaviour, structure-aware splitting (headings, tables, code), PDF/HTML extraction artefacts, metadata to keep per chunk, stale or duplicated chunks after re-ingestion, parent-child (small-to-big) retrieval. v5 already has one 'chunking/hybrid/freshness trade-offs' record (smi-g0010).

topic: Retrieval strategies (dense, BM25, hybrid, RRF, query rewriting, MMR)
guidance: Dense vs sparse failure modes (exact identifiers, rare terms, paraphrase), hybrid score fusion (why raw scores can't be added; reciprocal rank fusion with a tested implementation), BM25 mechanics (tf saturation, length normalisation, tested implementation), MMR for diversity (tested), query rewriting/HyDE/multi-query trade-offs, metadata pre- vs post-filtering.

Bi-encoder vs cross-encoder trade-offs, how many candidates to rerank (latency/recall), context ordering and lost-in-the-middle (hedge: empirical, model-dependent), deduplicating and compressing retrieved context, citation/attribution handling, token budgeting of the prompt.

topic: RAG evaluation (recall@k, MRR, nDCG, faithfulness, golden sets, LLM judges)
guidance: Retrieval metrics with tested implementations (recall@k, MRR, nDCG with a worked example), building a golden set and its biases, separating retrieval failure from generation failure, faithfulness vs answer relevance vs correctness, LLM-as-judge biases and calibration against humans (hedge), statistical noise with small eval sets. v5 already has a RAG-evaluation/retrieval-metrics question (smi-h0003 family) - go beyond it.

topic: Vector databases and index operations (filters, freshness, updates, cost)
guidance: Metadata filtering vs ANN recall, deletes/updates and index rebuilds, freshness of newly ingested documents, sharding/replication and memory cost arithmetic (computed), multi-tenancy isolation, hybrid support. Avoid naming product limits, prices or quotas (time-sensitive); discuss mechanisms.

Given symptoms (right document retrieved but answer wrong; answer fluent but unsupported; good offline metrics but bad user feedback; quality drop after re-indexing; wrong answers for acronyms/IDs), diagnose with a step-by-step triage and the measurements that separate causes. v5 has one 'RAG hallucination triage' record (smi-g0010 / NLP) - use different symptoms and decision logic.
